params.message:
Remove what nothing uses; the Buffer page draws the shared timeline

The Buffer page kept its own copy of the timeline chart; it uses SignalTimeline's
now. Patterns fetched /pipeline-stats on every visit and Buffer fetched it twice,
for values nothing showed. Unused phase lists, a button, two hooks, a query name,
leftover variables and the TypeScript type packages go. Lint ceiling 42 to 24.
